title: AE2 Random Sorting
description: Very simple mod that only adds random sorting to AE2 terminals.
body:
# AE2 Random Sorting

**Now available on the client side only**

Very simple mod that only adds random sorting to AE2 terminals.  
The random order is powered by SecureRandom and SHA-256, which is wildly overqualified for arranging your ingots.
Nothing else, so if you want fancy tweaks, check out other mods.
